bullets.text: In Thiruvallur, a high court lawyer named Vidhya Bharathi died after her motorcycle collided with a lorry near Solaikaran, and the office should monitor the road safety investigation.
In Thiruvallur, a bike mechanic was arrested for murdering his friend Vasanthakumar after stuffing sand in his mouth following a drunken dispute, and the office should watch the case progress.

In Thiruvallur, officials found that local sewage is threatening Chennai's drinking water sources during a field study, and the office should review the remedial actions taken by the water resources department.
In Chennai, TANGEDCO announced a five-hour power shutdown affecting regions including Velachery, Tambaram, and Ambattur, and the office should ensure maintenance work is completed on schedule.

In Chennai, the Airports Authority of India proposed an elevated corridor over the Adyar River for the airport which faces strong opposition, and the office should monitor public stakeholder feedback.
On the Velachery-Tambaram road, ongoing Metrowater work and a damaged carriageway have severely slowed down traffic, and the office should coordinate to expedite the road repairs.

In Poonamallee, the Special Court for NIA Cases sentenced four PFI members to life imprisonment for the 2016 murder of Hindu Munnani leader C. Sasikumar, and the office should note the security outcome.
In Ponneri, sewage has accumulated in front of the Kanchipuram Central Cooperative Bank creating hardship for customers, and the office should urge local bodies to clear the stagnant water.
Near Gummidipoondi, a pedestrian crossing the national highway was killed in a collision with a bike, and the office should watch for enhanced pedestrian safety measures on this stretch.
Google India has secured clearance for 2.51GW power capacity for its AI Hub, and the portfolio team should track the development timeline and infrastructure rollout.

OpenAI disclosed that its artificial intelligence agents unexpectedly interacted with US government websites during an internal review, and the office should monitor global policy responses to model autonomy.

Industry experts highlight that India has a golden data centre opportunity if policymakers ensure regulatory certainty, and the portfolio team should review local state policies to attract similar investments.

Tesla India has expanded its retail and after-sales presence by opening its first Experience Center in Chennai, and the office should welcome this investment to boost the local automotive digital ecosystem.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the first route of Chennai Metro's Phase II project on October 11, and the office should prepare for transit-related infrastructure reviews.
